text: Carrying a split log at the hearth: E aimed at the hearth, the chimney or the floor right under the visible woodpile rack does nothing but repeat 'Stack it on the woodpile by the hearth'. The woodpile is a thin rack of posts whose 2 stacked logs are tiny stubs; it needs a near-exact aim and is not in reach unless you stand right over it. Expected E with a log near the hearth to stack it (like debris' 12-degree forgiveness).

The aim label 'The fire' is drawn right over the flames in the hearth, hiding the fire the player just lit; the crosshair label sits at screen centre just above the target. Expected the label to sit below the crosshair (as other labels do) or fade once the fire is lit.

After the fire takes hold the Welcome checklist grows to 9 lines (Ada's brief) and runs down to mid-screen: 'Something of home on the walls' collides with the centre aim label 'The fire' and covers the top half of the hearth. The status lines also stack below. Expected the brief to collapse or the HUD to keep clear of the centre.

Restoration playback (T, and the automatic reveal) ends on the finished cabin with the player's own avatar standing on the rug squarely in front of the newly lit fire, blocking the hearth, and Ada in the rocking chair shows only as a purple skirt: the quilt over the chair back hides her upper body and face. The money shot of the game is obscured. See shots/t10.png and shots/replay_grid.png (shot taken now shows the world after playback).

Ada Lark in the rocking chair (Done step, tick ~32000) sits turned about 90 degrees from the chair: the quilted chair back is at her right side instead of behind her, the near armrest passes through her lap and her skirt pokes out past the rockers. From the hearth side she reads as perched sideways on the chair. Expected her seated facing the same way as the chair, back against the quilt.

Standing at the stall fence with the crosshair squarely on the mare's body, the aim label reads 'Stall' (no hint), not the mare; pt walkto mare also stops 2.8 m away, 'stuck' against the fence. The stall's pick volume seems to swallow the mare, so a player can't tell how to tend her (curry comb 9) from here. Expected the mare's name and a hint when aimed at her.

With the hearth lit and Ada home (Done, ~3:28 pm), the cabin seen from the yard and from the west side has no stone chimney stack above the roof and no smoke or glow at all, although inside there is a full stone chimney breast. The 'firelit chimney' payoff of the Kindle step is invisible from outside; the warm cabin looks exactly as it did before. Expected a chimney stack through the roof with smoke once the fire is lit.
